requiredOwnerInputs.label: Canonical workflow approval
notes: Decide whether Project Edit Brief becomes default first-pass workflow, remains optional, or is internal-only.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Durable root schema approval
notes: Approve edit_briefs/edit_cues durable roots and any required child-table columns.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Auth/access policy approval
notes: Approve workspace/project/session role matrix and archive/admin boundaries.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Supabase security approval
notes: Approve RLS, explicit grants, Storage policies, service-role boundaries, migration/typegen validation, and rollback.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Media lifecycle approval
notes: Approve uploads, private artifacts, retention/deletion, signed URL delivery, and metadata-only attachment upgrade path.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Planner integration approval
notes: Approve Brief Plan Hint entry into approved plan snapshots, priority rules, conflict handling, and revision reset behavior.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Credit/cost approval
notes: Approve estimates, reservations, spend/release/refund, cost metering ownership, and no silent overage behavior.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Provider/model approval
notes: Approve Qwen Marker Chat, Qwen2.5-VL visual context, model/license review, prompt redaction, and fallback rules.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Worker/render approval
notes: Approve worker consumers, idempotency keys, artifact manifests, QA gates, render readiness, progress events, and rollback.

requiredOwnerInputs.label: Operations approval
notes: Approve monitoring, incident runbook, privacy/legal, security, deployment owner, rollback owner, beta cohort owner, and support escalation.
